messages:
People Ops: Quick share Drafting a one-line OKR + evidence storyboard for the review packet. Goal: one line outcome + one metric + one next step. Copy-pasteable in reviews and manager notes. Thoughts? :memo:

rachel: Love the minimalism. Can we add a single sentence for context when things are cross-functional?

omar: Agree. Also include where to find the metric (dashboard link) so reviewers can validate during calibration.

People Ops: Good call Hereis a pasteable template + examples:

```
OKR STORYBOARD (one line + meta)
- Outcome (1 line): What changed and why it mattered
- Evidence (1 line): metric + link e.g., "p50 latency -12% (dash.com/p/123)"
- Next step (1 line): owner/action for next quarter
- Context (1 short phrase, optional): cross-team / infra / product
```

Example A (feature): "Outcome: Rolled out cached routing, cutting enterprise per-token cost 14%; Evidence: billing delta + dash.company.com/r/444; Next step: onboard QE for EU rollout; Context: product+infra"

Example B (platform): "Outcome: Reduced p95 tail by 10% on heavy routes via KV cache fixes; Evidence: grafana/r/77; Next step: extend fix to low-volume lanes; Context: infra"

vishal: Nice. Can we add a tiny manager micro-reply (3 words) pattern so calibration notes stay short? e.g., "Amplify + Next owner"

People Ops: Yup. Suggested micro-reply formats: "Amplify + Owner?", "Approve rollout", "Dev skill: mentoring". We'll include these as copy options.

tina: Two asks: 1) Add a short line for compensation/leveling signals if the work maps to promotion criteria. 2) Can we attach a 1-sentence benefit/policy note for folks who took parental leave (so reviewers consider adjusted scope)?

People Ops: Added both items: a single tag line `promo-signal: {leadership | impact | scope}` and `scope-note: leave-adjusted` for cases where scope was limited by approved leaves. We'll add guidance in the packet on how reviewers should interpret `scope-note`.

comp-bot: Reminder: I'll append this storyboard to the review kickoff email and the shared packet PDF. React with :white_check_mark: to approve final copy.

omar: Approved. Minor tweak: change wording from "next step" -> "next owner + due" to be more actionable.

People Ops: Updated to `Next step: owner + quarter/due`. Finalizing and dropping into the kickoff email and the review docs page. Thanks all! :rocket:
